summary: Megan Holdings Limited, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing the effectiveness date for its previously approved share consolidation. The Board approved a 1-for-30 consolidation ratio, replacing an earlier 1-for-40 plan, effective on the Nasdaq Capital Market on September 17, 2026. Trading will continue under symbol MGN, with fractional shares rounded up to whole shares. This is a routine corporate action (reverse stock split) rather than a special situation; no strategic event, change of control, or capital restructuring in the traditional sense is involved. Watch for operational risks post-consolidation.
